name: devops-guru
description: Amazon DevOps Guru is a fully managed service that helps you identify anomalous behavior in business critical operational applications.

subcommands.name: add-notification-channel
subcommands.description: Adds a notification channel to DevOps Guru.

subcommands.name: delete-insight
subcommands.description: Deletes the insight along with the associated anomalies, events and recommendations.

subcommands.name: describe-account-health
subcommands.description: Returns the number of open reactive insights, the number of open proactive insights, and the number of metrics analyzed in your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: describe-account-overview
subcommands.description: For the time range passed in, returns the number of open reactive insight that were created, the number of open proactive insights that were created, and the Mean Time to Recover (MTTR) for all closed reactive insights.

subcommands.name: describe-anomaly
subcommands.description: Returns details about an anomaly that you specify using its ID.

subcommands.name: describe-event-sources-config
subcommands.description: Returns the integration status of services that are integrated with DevOps Guru as Consumer via EventBridge.

subcommands.name: describe-feedback
subcommands.description: Returns the most recent feedback submitted in the current Amazon Web Services account and Region.

subcommands.name: describe-insight
subcommands.description: Returns details about an insight that you specify using its ID.

subcommands.name: describe-organization-health
subcommands.description: Returns active insights, predictive insights, and resource hours analyzed in last hour.

subcommands.name: describe-organization-overview
subcommands.description: Returns an overview of your organization's history based on the specified time range.

subcommands.name: describe-organization-resource-collection-health
subcommands.description: Provides an overview of your system's health.

subcommands.name: describe-resource-collection-health
subcommands.description: Returns the number of open proactive insights, open reactive insights, and the Mean Time to Recover (MTTR) for all closed insights in resource collections in your account.

subcommands.name: describe-service-integration
subcommands.description: Returns the integration status of services that are integrated with DevOps Guru.

subcommands.name: get-cost-estimation
subcommands.description: Returns an estimate of the monthly cost for DevOps Guru to analyze your Amazon Web Services resources.

subcommands.name: get-resource-collection
subcommands.description: Returns lists Amazon Web Services resources that are of the specified resource collection type.

subcommands.name: list-anomalies-for-insight
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the anomalies that belong to an insight that you specify using its ID.

subcommands.name: list-anomalous-log-groups
subcommands.description: Returns the list of log groups that contain log anomalies.

subcommands.name: list-events
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the events emitted by the resources that are evaluated by DevOps Guru.

subcommands.name: list-insights
subcommands.description: Returns a list of insights in your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-monitored-resources
subcommands.description: Returns the list of all log groups that are being monitored and tagged by DevOps Guru.

subcommands.name: list-notification-channels
subcommands.description: Returns a list of notification channels configured for DevOps Guru.

subcommands.name: list-organization-insights
subcommands.description: Returns a list of insights associated with the account or OU Id.

subcommands.name: list-recommendations
subcommands.description: Returns a list of a specified insight's recommendations.

subcommands.name: put-feedback
subcommands.description: Collects customer feedback about the specified insight.

subcommands.name: remove-notification-channel
subcommands.description: Removes a notification channel from DevOps Guru.

subcommands.name: search-insights
subcommands.description: Returns a list of insights in your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: search-organization-insights
subcommands.description: Returns a list of insights in your organization.

subcommands.name: start-cost-estimation
subcommands.description: Starts the creation of an estimate of the monthly cost to analyze your Amazon Web Services resources.

subcommands.name: update-event-sources-config
subcommands.description: Enables or disables integration with a service that can be integrated with DevOps Guru.

subcommands.name: update-resource-collection
subcommands.description: Updates the collection of resources that DevOps Guru analyzes.

subcommands.name: update-service-integration
subcommands.description: Enables or disables integration with a service that can be integrated with DevOps Guru.
